> Report one issue per entry. Do not publish real employee records, private contact details, credentials, access tokens, or exploit instructions.

**Title:**

**Affected feature:** loading / search / department filter / card / dialog / persistence / responsive UI / build / documentation / other

**Severity:** Blocker / Critical / High / Medium / Low

## 3. Preconditions

List the starting page, filters, test data, viewport, and any configuration needed to reproduce the issue. Use only synthetic records.

## 5. Expected behavior

Describe the expected result and link the related requirement or feature description.

## 6. Actual behavior

Describe what occurred instead, including visible error text, layout breakage, or unexpected state.

## 7. Frequency and impact

- [ ] Always
- [ ] Often

Who is affected? What work is blocked? Is there a safe workaround?

## 8. Evidence

Attach a screenshot from a real running build or sanitized console output. Record commit and viewport. Redact URLs containing credentials and any personal data.

## 9. Privacy and security check

- [ ] No real employee data or personal contact details.
- [ ] No salary, address, phone, or HR-only information.
- [ ] No credentials, tokens, cookies, or localStorage dumps.
- [ ] No unrelated desktop or notification content in screenshots.
- [ ] If this is a security vulnerability, it is being reported privately through SECURITY.md.
